name: session-band
description: Band above the prompt: turn number, output speed, turn and session cost, prompt cache countdown and context fill; notifies before the cache expires. Optimized fork of johnnyvizz/claude-kit (MIT).

language.title: Band language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en or vi

cacheTtl.title: Main-thread prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: 1h: what Claude Code writes on a subscription; 5m: API-key sessions without the 1-hour cache

countdown.title: Cache countdown
countdown.description: minutes: whole minutes until the last 10 (the band redraws once a minute); seconds: mm:ss all the time, as the original

limits.title: Plan limits on the band
limits.description: on: 5-hour (and weekly, when wide) usage of the plan with a warning when the pace fills it before the reset; off: hidden

alerts.title: Threshold alerts
alerts.description: on: one alert per threshold (context 70/85%, plan limit 80/95%, session budget 75/100%); off: none

budgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: Alert at 75% and 100% of this session cost; empty for no budget

utcOffset.title: UTC offset for the cost history (hours)
utcOffset.description: auto: the runtime's time zone; or a number such as 7 when the runtime runs in UTC
